rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("rows:", len(rows), "cols:", len(rows[0]))
# ring region

def state(f):
    P=G=[];cur=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']<4: continue
        bd=n['boundary']; rs=[q[0] for q in bd]; cs=[q[1] for q in bd]

    return {'ball':P[0] if P else None,'gray':G[0] if G else None,'cursor':cur}
print("before:", state(current_frame))
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':24}])
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
print("after :", state(current_frame))
